datasets.license: No licence or terms of use are stated in the archive (readme, code_bk.txt) or on the download. The file is posted for public download on David Card's Berkeley faculty page (davidcard.berkeley.edu/data_sets.html) as the data set for his college-proximity paper; the seed task records it as 'Distributed publicly by the author for research use; no explicit licence stated'. Used here for non-commercial research replication, the purpose for which the author distributes it; raw and derived files are git-ignored and rebuilt by the logged runs, not redistributed. The underlying NLS Young Men data are public-use U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics survey data.

datasets.origin: Member code_bk.txt of proximity.zip: Card's codebook (column positions, labels, N/mean/s.d./min/max for 3,613 rows).
Member read1.sas of proximity.zip: Card's example SAS program that reads nls.dat and constructs exp76, exp762 and f1-f8.

Derived from nls-dat by code/prepare_data.py (run prepare-data): the 3,010 rows with non-missing lwage76, all 52 codebook variables (raw tokens) plus exp76, exp762, age762, f1-f8. 603 rows dropped (missing lwage76). See data/CODEBOOK.md.
